newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOVERNMENT APPROVES BUDGET PLAN FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT APPROVES BUDGET PLAN FORECASTS.

text.p: The government has approved the major economic forecasts on which the 1998 national budget has been drawn up, the government press office said on Thursday.
The finance ministry in the budget proposal plans gross domestic product (GDP) of 42.31 billion litas in 1998 after 36.6 billion litas in 1996.
The plan was approved at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday, the press office said in a statement.
It also proposed six percent inflation in 1998. The ministry sees revenues to the national budget of 8.8 billion litas and spending at 9.4 billion litas.
The finance ministry also plans that the budget deficit should not exceed 600 million litas in 1998, 67 million litas less than in 1997.
The planned deficit would be 1.4 percent of GDP compared with 1.9 percent in 1997.
